about: Fort's skin, the one source for colours, strokes and type on the Mac, iPhone and web. Cool, not cartoon: near-black night with a cool light mode, hairline edges, square corners, condensed caps for titles and system type for everything else. The game is the live layer on top: cyan holographic glow for work in progress, gold for what needs you. Run `node successor/design/tokens.mjs --write` after changing it.

line.use: Hairline edges of panels, bars and bubbles.

caption.use: Tags: section labels and status lines. Text on it is ink.

captionInk.use: Text on gold, cyan and green fills.

accent.use: Quest gold: the one primary action and what needs you.

working.use: Status: an agent is working. Holographic cyan.

glow.use: The holographic glow around live or selected things.

needsYou.use: Status: waiting on you. Same gold as the accent.

failed.use: Status: failed. White text on it.

body.css: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
